analysis_steps.goal: Fit disk geometry from HST dust lane

method.value: Reference points along the F702W dust arc defined in SAODS9 and fit with an ellipse, with 1000 bootstrap/Monte Carlo realisations displacing points within the PSF FWHM

evidence.quote: reference points across the arc dust lane using `SAODS9` were defined and then fit to an ellipse using $N=1000$ bootstrapping and Monte Carlo simulations
corresponds to a physical area of $1.82\times1.82$ kpc$^2$ at 29.9 Mpc

analysis_steps.goal: Detect CO(2-1) and make moment maps

method.value: Spectral rebinning to 12.9 km/s, per-pixel Gaussian fits for intensity, centroid and dispersion; pixels below 95% confidence masked

evidence.quote: We fit Gaussian models along the spectral direction for each pixel in the cube, identifying the intensity, centroid, and dispersion of the CO(2-1) emission lines (moments 0, 1, and 2).
We fit Gaussian models along the spectral direction for each pixel in the cube

validation.value: Results compatible for ALMA and ARI-L cube versions

evidence.quote: These are compatible regardless of the version of the cubes analyzed.

analysis_steps.goal: Measure rotation velocity from summed spectrum

method.value: Sum spectra of significant pixels, measure half-maximum velocities by interpolation, 1000 Monte Carlo realisations displacing points by noise

evidence.quote: This process is repeated using $N=1000$ Monte Carlo simulations, with each data point being displaced by its spectral flux uncertainty (noise level).

method.value: Apply Smith et al. 2021 W50-inclination relation, propagating uncertainties of relation, inclination and spectra with Monte Carlo

evidence.quote: The uncertainties in their fitted relation are propagated using the Monte Carlo simulations, together with those in the inclination of the disk
together with those in the inclination of the disk (see Sec. [3.2](#subsec:results_hst))

findings_qualitative.value: CO(2-1) shows edge-on rotation, north edge approaching and south receding, with emission peaks at the disk edges

evidence.quote: The results show an unmistakable edge-on rotation pattern, with the north (south) edge of the disk moving towards (away from) the observer along the line of sight.

claims.hypothesis: Does NGC 5084 host a rotating molecular circumnuclear disk allowing an SMBH mass estimate?
claims.experiment: Rebinned archival ALMA CO(2-1) cube, per-pixel Gaussian fits, W50 and inclination from HST in the Smith+2021 relation
claims.finding: A polar rotating circumnuclear disk exists with SMBH mass of about 4.6e7 Msun

evidence.quote: No previous estimates have been reported for the mass of the SMBH of this galaxy.

why_this_data.value: Archival multi-wavelength data enable discovery; WISDOM ALMA data had no published NGC 5084 results

evidence.quote: none of the papers from the WISDOM project has published any result from the NGC 5084 observations analyzed in the present work

limitations_admitted.value: Original-resolution cube has insufficient per-pixel emission; detection only after rebinning to 12.9 km/s

evidence.quote: Initial inspection of the calibrated cube did not show sufficient emission per spaxel at the original spectral resolution of 1.3 km s$^{-1}$.
